{{Quote|How did the Kalindans do so much damage?|[[Sector Intelligence Chief|Chief]] [[Clivis Damand]]|<ref name="DoS" />}}
The '''Battle of Kalinda''' took place in the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in the times following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] consisting of the [[2391st Battle Squadron]], the [[6783rd Troop Line]] and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] [[1249th Mobile Corps]] moved to conquer the Kalinda system. They were intercepted by the [[Kalindan System Defense Force]] and the [[Kalindan Deep Space Fleet]].<ref name="DoS" />
